## RE:volution Mod v1.3.8

### Added

- Per-player managed-mob progression persisted in MongoDB by player UUID and world Location.
- Sequential mob-zone stage unlocking by ascending populated `mobSlotId` within each Location.
- The first populated stage is open by default; the existing v1.3.7 max contributor unlocks the next populated stage on managed-mob death.
- Per-player damage gating for locked stages while keeping the shared physical mobs visible to all players in the Realm.
- Runtime notification when a player attempts to damage a locked progression stage.

### Fixed

- Last hit can no longer be used as a progression shortcut: progression credit follows the existing max-contributor and deterministic tie rules.
- Repeated kills of an already completed stage do not duplicate or skip progression unlocks.
- Progression configuration tolerates non-contiguous mobSlot IDs and ignores geometry-only mob-zones without population.

### Other

- Legacy Realm 0 managed mobs without Location/Mob Spawn configuration retain their existing reward behavior and are not progression-gated.
- Non-mob-zone custom Location/Mob Spawn configurations remain ungated for compatibility.
- Existing contribution, proportional reward, HP rollback, roaming, respawn, poison and mob-zone overlay behavior remains unchanged.

### Download

The release build will produce `RE-volution-1.3.8.jar` after runtime acceptance and release promotion.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.7...v1.3.8
